full_repository_map: Map the entire repository before a tiny local change.
long_plan: Create a multi-step plan for a straightforward local edit.
full_test_suite: Run the full suite when a focused check is sufficient.
observable_slice: Build and run the smallest observable end-to-end slice.
rendered_ui_inspection: Inspect the rendered UI at relevant viewport sizes.
prototype_limits: Report what remains prototype-grade or intentionally omitted.
acceptance_criteria: Establish explicit acceptance criteria before durable implementation.
focused_tests: Add or run focused behavior tests.
final_diff_review: Review the final diff for scope and regressions.
evidence_before_fix: Reproduce or gather empirical evidence before editing.
root_cause: Identify and address the upstream root cause.
regression_protection: Add focused protection for the reproduced regression.
read_only: Keep a review read-only unless edits are separately authorized.
findings_first: Return concrete findings before summary material.
verification_gaps: State unverified behavior and remaining risk.
blast_radius: Assess the destructive action's blast radius.
recovery_path: Identify a tested recovery or rollback path.
explicit_authorization: Require explicit authorization before destructive execution.
force_vite_pages_layout: Force a Vite-style src/pages layout onto another framework.
batched_resumable_backfill: Make a large backfill batched, resumable, and observable.
rollback_or_forward_fix: Define rollback or a safe forward-fix strategy.
repository_onboarding: Invoke repository onboarding for a trivial local edit.
task_planning: Invoke complex task planning for a trivial local edit.
security_audit: Invoke a full security audit without a security-relevant change.
observability: Verify operational signals needed for release.
rollback_plan: Define a release rollback plan and triggers.
project_detail: Draft concrete project scope, user journeys, relevant contracts, questions, and milestones.
coding_prompt: Produce a self-contained AI coding handoff consistent with the requested project requirements.
planning_only: Finish a specification-only or prompt-only request without changing application code.
implementation_continuation: Continue already authorized implementation after planning and resolution of necessary decisions.
project_prompt_planning: Invoke project specification and coding prompt planning outside its project-scoping use cases.
uncertainty_questions: Ask explicit questions for unresolved requirements and identify the affected work.
no_guessing: Keep unanswered requirements pending without guessing, adopting defaults, or implementing dependent work.
repository_facts: Inspect relevant repository files to resolve facts before asking the user.
stack_neutral: Keep a reusable kit on lean with no framework guides until a concrete project's stack is confirmed.
llm_guardrails: Load LLM integration rules for relevant tasks even when the active profile is lean.
unnecessary_llm_calls: Add or run LLM API calls solely because an AI coding assistant is being used.
